content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am using [product_name] version 4 and recently upgraded my computer to Windows Vista. I managed to run this version on my PC, but I need to use version 5. Previously, I upgraded to version 5 on my old machines via the internet. Is it possible to upgrade without buying a new version 5 disk? I succeeded in getting [product_name] version 5.0.22 to run on Vista without the CD. I am preparing to share the steps here soon. To summarize: Use the procedure mentioned before to run version 4 from the CD. Open the program and update from the update center, one update at a time, before selecting version 5. Updating Java is necessary before this works. When version 5 opens asking for the language option, do not select finish; instead, choose your language, accept the terms, etc. The installation window may freeze, requiring Ctrl-Alt-Del to close. Afterwards, check your hard drive for a new folder. Adjust the icon's properties and compatibility as done before. Start the program from this folder and use the update center for the version .22 upgrade. No CD is needed.
